title: Changes of the peri-implant soft tissue thickness after grafting with a collagen matrix
authors: Zafiropoulos GG, Deli G, Hoffmann O, John G. J Indian Soc Periodontol. 2016 Jul-Aug;20(4):441-445. doi: 10.4103/0972-124X.181245.
supports: Clinical study from the botiss mucoderm (porcine collagen soft-tissue matrix) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “Within the limitations of this study, it could be concluded that mCM leads to a significant increase of peri-implant soft-tissue thickness, with good histological integration and replacement by soft tissue and may serve as an alternative to connective tissue grafting” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
